integrity: The exact formula is proved by equilibrium best responses and inclusion-exclusion. The asymptotic limit is proved analytically; finite enumeration is used only as a small-instance check.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic holds only for fixed k and uniform sampling over labelled pure-equilibrium strategy profiles in a loopless complete directed graph; it is not a behavioral equilibrium-selection prediction and does not cover arbitrary networks or growing k.
title: Equilibrium multiplicity concentrates near maximal provision in complete public-goods networks
